evidences.notes:
The Master Services Agreement was executed on June 8, 2026 and signed by Aisha Verma, Co‑founder & CTO, who had authority to bind Tandem Health. [1]

The Agreement explicitly states that the individual signing for the Company represents that they are authorized to bind the Company. [2]

Payments for all milestones are to be made from Tandem Health’s PayPal business account billing@tandemhealth.io. [3]

Milestone 1 and Milestone 2 were paid via that PayPal account on 2026‑06‑30 and 2026‑07‑29 respectively, each with a completed status. [4][5]

Milestone 3 invoice MLD‑0019 was paid on 2026‑08‑28 via the same PayPal account, and the transaction is marked completed. [6][7]

The code for Milestone 3 (clinician dashboard) was merged on 2026‑08‑28 (PR #212), included in 23 production deployments, and clinicians are using it daily. [8][9][10]

Under MSA §5, all code delivered becomes Company property upon payment of the related milestone invoice. [11]

The chargeback was filed after Aisha Verma left the company; Ben Carter, the new CEO, was not aware of the existing agreement, which is an internal hand‑off issue rather than an unauthorized transaction. [12][13][14]

Because the deliverables have been provided, accepted, and are in active use, reversing the payment would deprive Tandem Health of a product it already owns under the contract. [10][11]

We are happy to schedule a brief call with Ben Carter to clarify any remaining concerns and confirm the ownership transfer, but no refund is due. [13]

Payments for all milestones are to be made from Tandem Health’s PayPal business account billing@tandemhealth.io. [3]

Milestone 1 and Milestone 2 were paid via that PayPal account on 2026‑06‑30 and 2026‑07‑29 respectively, each with a completed status. [4][5]

Milestone 3 invoice MLD‑0019 was paid on 2026‑08‑28 via the same PayPal account, and the transaction is marked completed. [6][7]

Because the deliverables have been provided, accepted, and are in active use, reversing the payment would deprive Tandem Health of a product it already owns under the contract. [10][11]

We are happy to schedule a brief call with Ben Carter to clarify any remaining concerns and confirm the ownership transfer, but no refund is due. [13]
